headline: Customer support still leads the complaints, with prices and late delivery close behind.
comparison_note: Against October 2026 (from the October report): average rating 3.99 vs 3.98, 1-star share 19.1% vs 18.7%. Ratings are flat, while 1-star reply coverage rose from 39.1% to 51.7%. This covers 7 days, so expect more noise than a full month.
release_note: Version 20.0.0 stands out, with a 1-star share well above the period's, on 121 reviews. Version 20.0.1 is doing better than the main version, 19.9.9. Reviews with no app version are the usual outlier.
asks_heading: Three asks for the coming week

actions.title: Fix how tickets get closed
actions.text: Support comes up in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, the top theme again. Users say issues are pushed to email and left open. Audit a sample of closed tickets for real resolution.
actions.measure: support share of complaints next week

actions.title: Make fees easier to see
actions.text: Prices and fees come up in [[complaints.share@code=price|pct]] of written complaints, and the most agreed-with review this week, with [[loudest.thumbs_up#0|int]] thumbs-up, says Zomato shows higher prices and gives no good offers. Review how packing, platform and delivery fees are shown before checkout.

actions.title: Check what went wrong in 20.0.0
actions.text: Version 20.0.0 has a 1-star share of [[versions.one_star_share@version=20.0.0|pct]] against [[kpis.one_star_share#0|pct]] for the period. Compare its 1-star reviews with those on 20.0.1 before the next rollout.
